# what the Linux build installs on Ubuntu 22.04 with the savoury1 PPAs
# (.github/workflows/build.yml): darktable's AppImage list
# (darktable/.github/workflows/nightly.yml) without the features
# scripts/build.sh turns off, the build dependencies of libheif and exiv2
# (app/scripts/build_linux_deps.sh), which are built from source rather
# than installed, and Tauri's

# toolchain; darktable needs gcc 12 or later
gcc-12
g++-12
cmake
ninja-build
ccache
git
pkg-config
patchelf
libfuse2
file
gettext
intltool
perl
po4a
xsltproc
libxml2-utils
python3-jsonschema

# darktable
libarchive-dev
libcairo2-dev
libcurl4-gnutls-dev
libglib2.0-dev
libgtk-3-dev
libjson-glib-dev
liblcms2-dev
liblensfun-dev
liblensfun-bin
liblensfun-data-v1
libpng-dev
libpotrace-dev
libpugixml-dev
librsvg2-dev
libsqlite3-dev
libtiff5-dev
libwebp-dev
libxml2-dev
zlib1g-dev
libjpeg-turbo8-dev
libopenjp2-7-dev
# from the PPAs: Ubuntu 22.04 has no libjxl, and older libavif and openexr
# than darktable reads
libavif-dev
libjxl-dev
libopenexr-dev
libimath-dev

# libheif and exiv2
libde265-dev
libaom-dev
# libaom-dev's cmake config names /usr/bin/aomdec, which libheif's FindAOM checks for
aom-tools
# and the PPA's libaom links against libwebm
libwebm-dev
libopenh264-dev
libsharpyuv-dev
libinih-dev
libbrotli-dev
libexpat1-dev

# Tauri
libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev
libjavascriptcoregtk-4.1-dev
libsoup-3.0-dev
libayatana-appindicator3-dev
libssl-dev
